decision_question: Is okhp3-linkedin-message ready for draftable distribution in social-posting within its stated scope?
acceptance_criteria: Fills a family gap without duplicating an existing package
Public-neutral: no identifying values in package or fixtures
Recipient facts require a source; limits are not hard-coded as guarantees
At least one normal, edge, and untrusted-input case

shared_model_or_source_limits: Single-agent analytical review: evidence, outcome, safety-portability, disruptor and negotiator roles ran in one model context with a shared source set (the originating work session), so concordance is correlated evidence, not independent agreement.

claim_ledger.claim: Connection-note limit planning default is 200 characters with live-counter confirmation
claim_ledger.evidence: Secondary sources conflict (200 vs 300); primary LinkedIn Help page could not be fetched. An earlier session draft used 300, which this default corrects.

claim_ledger.claim: Third-party announcements can misstate a recipient's current role
claim_ledger.evidence: Originating session: a 2024 appointment announcement was superseded by the recipient's profile showing a later role change.
Stated conditionally ('when the host supports it'); not host-tested.

claim_ledger.claim: No existing social-posting package drafts private messages
claim_ledger.evidence: Family routing table lists post, comment, angles, and voice only.

claim_ledger.claim: LinkedIn-bound text should pass the family voice skill
claim_ledger.evidence: rc1 omitted the okhp3-linkedin-voice pass that the family contract requires for LinkedIn text; added as step 8.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: The package duplicates an existing LinkedIn DM skill.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Compare against the skillz social-posting inventory and the owner's host-installed skills.
falsification_hypotheses.result: Failed in skillz (no DM package). Survived on the owner's host, where a dictation-to-DM skill exists; resolved by improving that host skill instead of installing a duplicate there.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: The scrub would not have caught the originating session's real miss (a clinical term used as metaphor).
falsification_hypotheses.test: Check message-scrub.md and the loaded-language case.
falsification_hypotheses.result: Failed: the scrub names clinical metaphors explicitly and a development case covers it.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Tier defaults push the agent to invent warmth.
falsification_hypotheses.result: Failed: tiers come from user statements; missing signal defaults to dormant after one question.

limitations: Single-agent analytical review: evidence, outcome, safety-portability, disruptor and negotiator roles ran in one model context with a shared source set (the originating work session), so concordance is correlated evidence, not independent agreement.
No live with/without-skill benchmark and no unseen holdout were run. Development cases are designed, not executed.
LinkedIn limits rest on conflicting secondary sources retrieved 2026-11-09.
expiry: Re-review on any LinkedIn surface change, a real failure, or before claiming benchmarked status.
follow_up: Run development cases with and without the skill in an isolated runner
Confirm limits against LinkedIn Help when retrievable
